model_annotations.Bulgarian:
Тази фигура е линейна графика, която илюстрира промените в абсолютната средна стойност на скритите състояния през различни слоеве на една мрежа.

Оста X е обозначена като "Layer" и има линейна скала с диапазон от 0 до 22. Единицата на оста X е цяло число и етикетите са разположени на интервали от 5.

Оста Y е обозначена като "Abs Mean" и също има линейна скала с диапазон от 0 до 4. Единицата на оста Y няма изрично посочена, но изглежда да бъде безразмерна величина. Етикетите са разположени на интервали от 1.

Графиката съдържа три линии, всяка от които представя различен тип средна стойност на скритите състояния: 
- "hidden state mean before gate" е представена с пунктирана синя линия,
- "hidden state mean after gate" е представена с оранжева пунктирана линия и 
- "hidden state mean of baseline" е представена с плътна зелена линия.

Синята линия започва приблизително от 0 на слой 0 и се увеличава постепенно до около 0.5 на слой 10, след което има рязък скок до 4 на слой 22.

Оранжевата линия и зелената линия остават близо до 0 през всички слоеве, като имат лека вариация около 0.

Средните стойности на всяка линия са дадени в легендата: 
- "hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71", 
- "hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05" и 
- "hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04".
model_annotations.Chinese:
The figure displays the absolute mean values across different layers for three distinct hidden state means. 

The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and has a numeric range from 0 to 23, with a uniform interval of 1, but no unit is specified. 

The y-axis is labeled "Abs Mean" and has a numeric range from 0 to 4, with a uniform interval of 1, but no unit is specified.

The figure contains three lines: a blue dashed line representing "hidden state mean before gate" with an average of 0.71, an orange dotted line representing "hidden state mean after gate" with an average of 0.05, and a green solid line representing "hidden state mean of baseline" with an average of 0.04. The blue line starts near 0 at Layer 0, fluctuates slightly between 0 and 1 from Layer 1 to Layer 19, then sharply increases to approximately 4.2 at Layer 23. The orange and green lines remain near 0 across all layers, with minor fluctuations.
model_annotations.English: This plot illustrates the absolute mean of hidden states across different layers, comparing three conditions: before gate, after gate, and baseline. The x-axis represents Layer, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 23, marked at intervals of approximately 5 units. The y-axis represents Abs Mean, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 4, marked at intervals of 1 unit. The plot contains three lines: a blue dashed line representing the hidden state mean before gate, an orange dotted line representing the hidden state mean after gate, and a green solid line representing the hidden state mean of baseline. The blue line starts at approximately 0.1 and fluctuates slightly around 0.5 until layer 18, then sharply increases to around 4.2 at layer 23; the orange line starts at 0 and remains steady around 0.05; the green line starts at approximately 0 and remains steady around 0.05.
model_annotations.German:
The graph shows the hidden state mean across different layers. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," has a linear scale with values ranging from 0 to 23, with tick labels at regular intervals of 5 units and estimated values in between. The y-axis, labeled "Abs Mean," also has a linear scale with values from 0 to 4, with tick labels at intervals of 1 unit. 

The graph displays three lines: a blue dashed line representing the "hidden state mean before gate" with an average of 0.71, an orange dotted line for the "hidden state mean after gate" with an average of 0.05, and a green solid line for the "hidden state mean of baseline" with an average of 0.04. The blue line starts at approximately 0.2 at layer 0 and remains relatively stable until layer 20, where it sharply increases to around 4.2 at layer 23. The orange and green lines remain close to 0 across all layers, with minimal fluctuation, and end at approximately 0.05 and 0.03, respectively, at layer 23.
